items.source: Extension of TransactionalEventListenerFactory, detecting invalid transaction configuration for transactional event listeners: Transactional only supported with Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW and Propagation.NOT_SUPPORTED.
items.translation: `TransactionalEventListenerFactory` 的扩展，用于检测事务性事件监听器的无效事务配置：仅支持 `Transactional` 注解配合 `Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW` 和 `Propagation.NOT_SUPPORTED`。
